# The Salt Vaults of Kerrig

## Chapter 1 — The Drowned Gate

The party arrives at Kerrig, a fishing town built over flooded salt mines.
Mayor Ilsa Vane hires them to find three missing miners.

Key beat: the party learns the mines were sealed deliberately.

NPCs:
- Ilsa Vane — mayor, pragmatic, hiding a bribe
- Odrin Salt — old miner, knows the lower tunnels

## Chapter 2 — Below the Waterline

The lower tunnels flood on a tidal cycle. The missing miners are alive,
trapped behind a collapsed shaft.

Key beat: the collapse was caused by a cult of Umberlee.
